40961.Title: A Cruise for Two - 4 Night Chan May Cruise 11/16
40961.Description:
Enjoy a sailing for 2 on Royal Caribbeans Spectrum of the Seas out of Hong Kong, China for 4 nights sailing on 11/16/2026 in an interior cabin. Taxes, gratuities, and other fees may apply. 

Dive headfirst into adventure on a 4-night cruise to discover the wonders of Asia. Depart from Hong Kong, China on Spectrum of the Seas for your epic journey through unforgettable landscapes and world-renowned cities. Gaze in awe and wonder at wow-worthy architecture and natural beauty as you travel throughout the region.

41230.Title: 7-Day Cruise to the Mexican Riviera from San Diego
41230.Description:
Sunshine, coastal views and the Mexican Riviera await! Set sail from San Diego, CA aboard Norwegian Star and discover a vibrant mix of beautiful beaches, colorful destinations and unforgettable experiences. Enjoy a complimentary 7-day cruise on select sailings from January 2 through February 6, 2027.

Experience the laid-back charm of the Mexican Riviera with opportunities to explore local culture, stroll along scenic coastlines, soak up the sun or simply relax with the ocean all around you. From picturesque ports to days at sea, there’s plenty to enjoy along the way.

Your Mexican Riviera adventure starts in San Diego. Pack your bags and get ready to discover somewhere new aboard Norwegian Star.

Popouts.Title: Terms and Conditions
Popouts.Body:
Limited to one Norwegian Cruise Line in-app reward purchase every 90 days. Reservations must be made by November 30, 2026. Offer only valid on select 7-day sailings from San Diego, CA to the Mexican Riviera on Norwegian Star. Sail from January 2, 2027, to February 6, 2027. This reward is non-refundable after purchased in the rewards store. Complimentary cruise fare is reserved for the player who has claimed this offer (referred to as the 'Cruise Coupon Holder') and the second guest of the stateroom. It is applicable for a single discount per cruise reservation and is restricted to redemption by the individual specifically named ('Cruise Coupon Holder') on the coupon. It is applicable solely to new bookings and cannot be applied to existing reservations. This complimentary cruise fare is exclusively applicable towards the voyage fare and cannot be used towards gratuities, taxes or fees. Please note there could be up to a 72-hour delay for the application of the complimentary cruise fare towards your reservation, and once funds are applied an updated confirmation will be sent out. Complimentary cruise fare is specified in USD and cannot be exchanged for any other currency when making a reservation with Norwegian Cruise Line. The Cruise Coupon Holder must be present onboard for the sailing. If the Cruise Coupon Holder is not onboard the sailing, Norwegian will charge the full cruise fare at the current rates for the individual guest who boarded. Complimentary cruise fare may not be used for payment of any other services or products offered by Norwegian or any other fees, charges or expenses incurred by the Passengers including, without limitation, airfare, ground transportation, fuel supplement fees, land programs, administration fees, travel insurance, gratuities, amenities, goods & services available for purchase onboard Norwegian ships. Complimentary cruise fare is valid only with a reservation made through Norwegian's Casino Reservation Centers. Reservation is subject to stateroom availability and cannot be combined with any other offer. Complimentary cruise fare may be used in conjunction with the payment for a higher category stateroom, subject to availability, and the payment of additional charges, which apply. Third and fourth passenger accommodations may be provided, subject to availability, at an additional charge based on Norwegian's prevailing rates. Promotional amenities are determined based on the stateroom offered not on the purchased upgrade. This complimentary cruise fare may not be sold, assigned or transferred, is non-refundable and may not be redeemed for cash. Offer may not be combined with existing group block rates, or any other offer or event. Additional onboard charges may apply. Norwegian reserves the right to modify the terms and conditions at any time. For the full terms and conditions of this offer, visit our website at ncl.com/onboard/casino/terms. We will need some information about you so we can facilitate your redemption. After you have clicked on “Confirm” to purchase, you will be presented with some fields to complete: name, email, address, phone number. By clicking on “Confirm” below, you are consenting to PLAYSTUDIOS collecting this information and sending it too Norwegian. Norwegian will use this information primarily to facilitate the redemption of your reward. Norwegian may use it to contact you about other goods or services that they provide. Norwegian’s use of your information will be subject to its privacy policy. Go to ncl.com for further information.
